item.title: Austin Regular Meeting: March 26, 2026
item.description:
Here are the key items from the Austin City Council agenda: * **Expanding Housing Options and Reforming Parking Rules:** Council will consider significant policy changes to allow for more housing types like townhomes and mixed-use developments ("missing middle housing"), reduce required off-street parking in transit areas, and explore separating parking fees from housing costs. They will also consider selling city land to develop affordable housing. * **Major Land Use and Parkland Decisions:** Public hearings include amending city sign and billboard regulations, a proposal to permanently use a portion of Auditorium Shores parkland for a reclaimed water line, and several disannexations of properties from the city limits as mandated by state law. * **Strategic Plans and City Infrastructure:** Council will vote on the Austin Homeless Strategies and Operations 2025-2027 Strategic Plan and update the city's overall transportation plan. They will also approve numerous contracts for essential city services and infrastructure projects, including a new facility for Austin Resource Recovery's reuse program.

item.title: Austin Austin Housing Finance Corporation: March 26, 2026
item.description:
Here's a summary of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's agenda: * **Meeting Focus:** The Austin Housing Finance Corporation will hold a meeting to address financing for local housing initiatives. * **Affordable Housing Loan:** The primary item on the agenda is considering a loan of up to $3.5 million to National Church Residences for an affordable housing development. * **"Sunday Village" Project:** This loan will support the "Sunday Village" project (previously known as Arbors at Creekside), located near 1026 Clayton Lane. * **Concise Agenda:** This meeting's agenda is brief, with no public hearings or other major policy debates scheduled.

item.title: Austin Work Session: March 24, 2026
item.description:
Here's a summary of the Austin City Council Work Session agenda: * **Addressing Homelessness:** Reviewing a strategic plan to guide Austin's efforts on homelessness from 2025-2027. * **Housing & Zoning Reforms:** Debating significant zoning changes to encourage more diverse housing types (like townhomes and cottages, known as "missing middle housing") and mixed-use developments. * **Public Hearing on Sign Regulations:** Holding a public hearing on proposed changes to sign regulations, potentially allowing larger, electronic advertising signs in public areas. * **I-35 Cap and Stitch Project Update:** Receiving a briefing on recommendations for the future I-35 Cap and Stitch project.

item.title: Austin Regular Meeting: March 12, 2026
item.description:
Here's a summary of the Austin City Council agenda: * **Major Infrastructure Funding:** Approving over $1.5 billion in funding and loans for the Walnut Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion and other water infrastructure improvements. * **Significant Land Use Changes:** Initiating the rezoning process for the 445-acre Jimmy Clay and Roy Kizer Golf Courses, potentially opening these public lands for new uses. * **Housing and Development Public Hearings:** Conducting public hearings on several large-scale land use and zoning amendments, including significant mixed-use developments in Montopolis and Oak Hill, and an update to a mixed-use project at 800 E. St. John Avenue to include deeper affordability. * **Lobbyist Transparency:** Considering updates to City lobbyist regulations to enhance transparency regarding direct communications with City officials.

item.title: Austin Austin Housing Finance Corporation: March 12, 2026
item.description:
